patch_description: This keeps the existing direct-link rewards, route ranking and selection, transit-pressure estimate, cut-congestion correction, and reciprocal-link terms. The targeted change is to reduce the strength of the route couplings for larger networks: many more route alternatives are available as n grows, so their combined influence may overwhelm the direct and congestion signals. The reduction is modest at n=15–16 and grows gradually beyond that, while leaving the route structure unchanged. It is a demand-only heuristic and does not guarantee improved evaluation scores.
